C1649.title: Record-Breaking Virtual Land Sale Stirs Metaverse Speculation
C1649.summary: In November 2021, a parcel of virtual land in Decentraland sold for about $2.4 million in cryptocurrency, setting a record for virtual real estate at the time. The buyer, Tokens.com's Metaverse Group, planned to use the property for digital fashion activities. The transaction also raised questions about valuation and speculation in metaverse land.
